gates: Database-management plus only relevant advisors for DB work
Live health/resource/freeze gates before broad production probes
Matched data/cache/concurrency/resource benchmarks and correctness parity before performance claims
Preserve Epic provenance, historical correctness, publication and restore evidence; FST storage stays on its required drive
Focused .NET or web tests; canonical documentation and node tools/check-docs.mjs
Release and destructive work require existing authorization and parity gates

always: Keep secrets out of evidence; preserve historical correctness, Epic provenance and publication boundaries.
Research grants no live mutation or destructive-operation authority; required FST data/scratch drive ownership remains unchanged.

research: Locate current source, canonical docs and reusable mechanisms before external alternatives.
Source alone cannot prove current performance or operational readiness; propose bounded matched measurements rather than invent gains.
implementation: Apply affected component contracts and relevant database advisors; retain rollback and source ownership.
validation: Use targeted existing tests, matched correctness/performance evidence, canonical documentation and check-docs.
release: Preserve existing authorization, live health/freeze, exact-object, parity and restore gates.

commands.web: cd FortniteFestivalWeb && corepack yarn test:unit <affected tests>
